items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Who did he work with that you know of? ... King Oliver, General Morton

ctx.x: H&T Tavern, huh? Yeah, that's right. Who did he work with that you know of?

King Oliver, General Morton, and a fella you don't know of. Huey Swift. He was the first Negro band in Chicago that went on the air. First one. He had a beat playing. I was good at him. Jeffery Tavern, the name was Jeffery Tavern, South Chicago and Jeffery. And the car dope, and the place closed it down.
Did you see him with Jelly Roll Morton or did he tell you about it? Oh Cliff?
